observation: S6-S8 did not establish the intended contextual memory and economic advantage; S9 is implemented but unrun and unconsumed. User requests a fully mapped S10 before implementation.
hypothesized_cause: Horizon/decision mismatch, weak conditional reliability, mixture complementarity and trading costs may contribute; the design does not claim these explain all prior losses.
change: Specify a separate finite-scenario S10: direct H4 joint price/dividend atoms; global/recent/context experts; delayed proper-score mixture optimization with local-to-global shrinkage; holdings-aware nominal/robust utility and exact fees.
predicted_effect: Context may improve joint forecast quality and consistent decisions may improve net wealth; global mixing or cash may remain superior.
discriminating_experiment: Proposed fixed pre-2017 retrospective protocol: 128 strategy, 48 benchmark and 16 ablation ledgers; two chronological folds; all simple controls, two primary comparisons and two block lengths. Not launched or authorized for execution by the design.
new_metric_boundary: S10 ES margin is a separate hypothesis; it cannot satisfy original 0.01-nat NLL. Retained 6% wealth objective remains explicit.
